description: Deterministic domain risk/trust evaluation returning ALLOW / REVIEW / BLOCK from observed evidence; external evidence may change between calls. USE WHEN: deciding if a domain is safe for interaction, onboarding, outreach or payment. DO NOT USE for operational inspection of DNS, HTTP/TLS, email posture or AI discovery surfaces; use domain_agent_discovery_check. For email suitability, use email_suitability_decision. Read-only; no domain actions or persistence.

domain.description: Bare public hostname (e.g., example.com). No protocol, path, query, or fragment. Localhost and IP literals rejected.
domain.title: Domain

name: domain_risk_trust_decision

confidence.description: Confidence in the decision (10-95). Based on evidence completeness and consistency; low confidence may nudge ALLOW to REVIEW.

decision.description: Trust decision (ALLOW/REVIEW/BLOCK) derived from observed risk, indicator strength, and evidence sufficiency; insufficient evidence may require REVIEW rather than ALLOW.

dmarc.description: DMARC records derived from observed DNS TXT records (v=dmarc1).

dns_record_states.description: Structured DNS-record observation and state information used by the decision.

dnssec_available.description: Whether DNSSEC evidence is available for the evaluated domain.

evidence_complete.description: Whether all evidence sources were available.

indicators.description: Observed risk indicators with different strengths and decision impact; their strength and combination contribute to risk_score and the resulting decision.

risk_level.description: Risk level derived from observed signals.

signals.description: Evidence source states (DNS, RDAP, TLS, HTTP, threat intel).

spf.description: SPF records derived from observed DNS TXT records (v=spf1).

threat_evidence.description: Structured threat-intelligence evidence contributing to the risk/trust assessment.

title: Domain Risk & Trust Decision
